topic.label: English
topic.desc: English: the study of literature, language and writing in English, from close reading and literary history to rhetoric and composition.

concepts: Interpreting texts through attention to diction, imagery, form, narrative and figurative language.
English-language literature from Old English through contemporary global Anglophone writing, in historical context.
Meter, rhyme, sound and form in poetry and the vocabulary for describing them.
Frameworks such as formalism, structuralism, feminism, Marxism, psychoanalysis and postcolonial theory used to read texts.
Grammar, usage, phonology, semantics and the history and varieties of the English language.
Argument, persuasion, academic and creative writing, revision and editing.
skills: Produces line-level interpretations of a passage and checks every claim against quoted textual evidence.
Analyses point of view, plot and character in fiction and checks the account against the text.
Traces a theme or motif across a work and checks each instance with cited passages.
Situates a text within its literary period and historical context and checks dates and attributions against sources.
Maps influence and allusion between authors and checks each link against documented evidence.
Scans lines of verse for meter and stress and checks foot counts and variations line by line.
Identifies fixed forms and rhyme schemes and checks them against the formal definition.
Reads a text through a chosen theoretical framework and checks that the framework is represented accurately.
Compares how different critical frameworks interpret the same text and checks each reading against its sources.
Parses sentence structure and identifies grammatical functions and checks analysis against a reference grammar.
Traces word origins and semantic change and checks each step against dictionary evidence.
Describes features of English varieties and checks examples against linguistic documentation.
Develops a thesis and argument outline and checks claims, evidence and counterargument for coherence.
Edits drafts for clarity, structure, grammar and citation style and checks against the assignment rubric.
Gives craft feedback on fiction and poetry drafts and checks suggestions against the writer's stated goals.
mcp: Translate text and documents across 100+ languages, with your preferred styles applied
Enhance responses with scholarly research and citations
